text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: SDK v2.4.1 + runtime v1.8.0. Model pinned for canary: redwood-3b-quant-v2. Canary size: 5%. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-sdk-runtime

maria: Heads up — infra already provisioned canary hosts in us-west-2. Watching infra metrics.

jason: Quick compatibility callout: SDK v2.4.1 changed streaming framing; runtime v1.8.0 added new KV-cache layout. We tested locally but not at scale with redwood-3b-quant-v2.

cheng: Seeing a couple of truncated streams on my dev repro with long context (~8k tokens) when runtime/v1.8.0 + SDK/2.4.1 + quant-v2. Might be KV cache indexing mismatch.

samir: Seen similar in canary logs: 
```
ERROR runtime: KVCacheMismatch: expected index 0x4f, got 0x3b
stack: runtime/cache.go:214
```

irene: Oof. That looks like a runtime/model KV layout incompat. We should decide: pause canary and roll back model pin, or roll back SDK to 2.4.0 for the canary traffic. Which is lower risk?

maria: Risk assessment: rolling back model to quant-v1 gives immediate safety (we already served quant-v1 yesterday). Rolling back SDK is faster to flip but SDK 2.4.0 lacks the framed-stream corrections we need long-term.

jason: If we roll back model for canary only, we can buy time to ship runtime 1.8.1 with KV migrator. I can produce a patch in the morning (ETA 6h).

cheng: Agree with model rollback for canary. That keeps production for most users stable and doesn't touch SDK for everyone.

samir: Ok doing rollback for canary. Runbook command: 
```
# pin model for canary group to previous variant
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/release/pin \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" \n  -d '{"target":"canary","model":"redwood-3b-quant-v1","reason":"KVCacheMismatch on quant-v2 with runtime 1.8.0"}'
```

deploy-bot: Canary update: pausing rollout and pinning canary to redwood-3b-quant-v1. Canary traffic now confirmed at 5% -> redwood-3b-quant-v1.

irene: Confirmed. Monitoring logs; no more KVCacheMismatch after pin.

maria: I'll update the change window notes and notify support. Also adding an entry to the release notes: "Canary paused for quant-v2 due to KV cache incompat with runtime 1.8.0; rollback to quant-v1 for canary."

jason: I'll open a runtime PR for 1.8.1 that includes KV cache migrator + compatibility tests. Linking here when ready. Plan: cut runtime 1.8.1, smoke test on canary hosts, unpin model after validation.

cheng: Add a short-term compatibility note for SDK: run SDK with env var REDWOOD_ENABLE_LEGACY_KV=1 to mitigate if teams hit this in staging. Not for prod long-term.

samir: Adding to the release checklist: 
- stop canary for quant-v2 (done)
- publish runtime/v1.8.1 by EOD
- smoke test model quant-v2 on runtime 1.8.1
- unpin canary to quant-v2 after validation
- update SDK docs about REDWOOD_ENABLE_LEGACY_KV

irene: +1 on checklist. I'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb for support engineers.

maria: Scheduling follow-up sync 09:30 UTC to validate runtime patch and plan unpin.

jason: Pushed draft PR: https://go/p/runtime-1.8.1-kvmigrator. Requesting review from eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: Note: change window extended if we need to re-run canary after runtime patch. Please coordinate before flipping traffic.

cheng: Thanks all. For the record — do not upgrade production SDKs yet; we'll keep SDK 2.4.1 in the SDK channel but call out the KV legacy env.

samir: Closing action items in the thread. Will add detailed notes to internal release doc after runtime PR merges.

maria: Great work and quick decisioning. :thumbsup:
